CURRENT RESEARCH STATE — 7 October 2026, Australia/Brisbane

DECISION
The strongest fully reconstructed result is the hard-energy discrimination law, selected for its self-contained proof, independent approaches, complete comparator and full-class finite-dimensional scope. The projected-Slater consequence has higher potential scientific reach but retains a new unimplemented counting-theorem dependency. Other consequential results are banked as research capital; they are not substitutes for further work on these leading mechanisms.

A. EXACT HARD-ENERGY DISCRIMINATION
Interface: known fixed finite H>=0 with unique zero ground, 0<E<=I and E|0>=|0>, parallel inputs, miss Tr(rho E^tensor n), exact support in Hsum<=Q. All separable inputs including mixtures and unequal products are the comparator. Input energy is charged; acquisition, idlers/adaptivity, nonzero false alarms, apparatus/control and preparation work are separate contracts.
Mechanism: energy-ordered upper Cholesky E=T* T, B=T^-1, A=B*B. Upper triangularity preserves cumulative energy cutoffs, so p_n(Q)=||B^tensor n P_Q||^-2 EXACTLY. This avoids exponentially damaging leakage in naive typical projection.
Full law: phi(s)=log||exp(-sH/2) A exp(-sH/2)||; g(c)=inf_s>=0[phi(s)+sc]. Uniformly in c>=0, n>=1, -log p_n(nc)=ng(c)-O(log(n+1)), with explicit fixed-(E,H,dimension) constants. The proof uses tensor-order converse and exact multinomial types of a tilted top eigenvector.
Free-use exponent: s*=inf{s:A<=exp(sH)}; -log p*(Q)=s*Q-O(logQ).
Separable law: levels h_j and ell_j=-log lambda_min(E restricted H<=h_j); exact finite allocation knapsack, asymptotic concave LP hull of (h_j,ell_j). eta=max ell_j/h_j. Advantage iff A is not <=exp(eta H).
Sharp structural principle: s*/eta <= number k of DISTINCT POSITIVE energy levels. Supremum k is approached by explicit weak rank-one effects with separated energies. Degeneracy does not increase this bound. At fixed nontrivial model equality for k>1 is not asserted.
Qutrit: H+=diag(1,2), E+=[[1/2,sqrt2/4],[sqrt2/4,3/4]]. s*=log((1+sqrt17)/2)=.9406136421072088, eta=log2, hard gain1.357018636860576; expected-energy exponent=(5/3)log2=1.155245300933242. Entanglement improves the fixed-use rate for EVERY0<c<2. Explicit Dicke probes have p<=C sqrt(Q+1) exp(-s*Q), an attainable second-order bound, not proved optimal second-order asymptotics.
Proofs: hard_energy_detection.

REPRODUCIBILITY AND VALIDATION BOUNDARY

Read START_HERE.txt and RESEARCH_STATE.txt before interpreting any computation.
The archive contains proof source, independent internal audits, exact and floating-point diagnostics, source provenance, failed routes, and continuation gates. It does not include third-party full manuscripts, an implemented counting FPRAS, a compiled quantum circuit, a Lean proof, or experimental data.

SELECTED CHECKS RERUN BY THE ROOT AGENT
From the extracted research_evidence directory, using Python 3 with NumPy and SymPy installed:

python3 work/agents/hard_energy/check_cholesky.py
python3 work/agents/group_geometry/spectral_certificate.py
python3 work/agents/release_frontier/check_transfer.py
python3 work/agents/gaussian_heralding/check_bounds.py

These scripts write diagnostic JSON alongside themselves. Run in a copy if preserving the archived file hashes is important. The group and Slater checks use only the Python standard library; the energy check uses NumPy; the optical check uses NumPy and SymPy. No large model, remote compute, FPRAS or quantum runtime is required.

Expected scopes and results are in research_evidence/work/root/ROOT_REPLAYS.json. Floating-point agreement is algebraic diagnostic evidence only. The exact checks establish their stated finite identities and certificates, not the complete theorems.

To regenerate the scientific illustration, run the following from the extracted research_evidence directory with NumPy and Matplotlib installed:

python3 work/root/plot_hard_energy.py

It creates outputs/hard_energy_tradeoff.png, .pdf and _data.json relative to that directory. The plot illustrates the proved variational formula numerically; it is not part of its proof.

MANUSCRIPTS
Both standalone .tex documents compiled successfully with the Codex desktop built-in LaTeX compiler on 7 October 2026. Open the .tex source in the native editor to read its PDF preview. Compilation establishes syntactic/layout processing only. The native compiler does not export a PDF into this archive.

INTEGRITY
MANIFEST.json lists SHA-256 hashes and sizes relative to this directory; it excludes itself and research_checkpoint.zip. research_evidence/MANIFEST.json lists hashes relative to research_evidence. Archive integrity and source provenance are separate from proof validity and historical novelty.
